checks.name: current_recovery_contract
checks.result: All 20 fixed conditions in contract 1.0.0 passed. Twelve runtime tests and one real CLI test cover concurrent revisions/sources, final fingerprint and mapping checks, seven process-death boundaries, damaged/newer source recovery and exactly one durable receipt.
criteria: 并发 expected_revision/fingerprint 冲突可重现，不能发生静默丢更新。
覆盖文件写前、写后、重索引前后的中断，pending proposal 可恢复且不能假报完成。

checks.name: recoverable_errors_and_lock_lifetime
checks.result: Red baselines retained: two tests failed for temporary I/O closing attempts, and one deterministic duplicate-descriptor test failed for delayed lock release. Temporary I/O/source-access failures now retain pending recovery, including retries after an earlier write; source lock ownership explicitly unlocks at scope exit. Updated tests pass.

checks.name: related_mutation_behavior
checks.result: 60 related tests passed: runtime held-path checks 4, source YAML mutations 4, Store proposal transactions 6, CLI proposal/work/complete 36 and MCP stdio 10. Workspace all-target check, locked distribution build, formatting and diff checks passed.

checks.name: actual_project_use
checks.result: The rebuilt binaries recorded observation and exact source progress through MCP in this project. Before/after snapshots match the real ledger and the final receipt resolves its original attempt. Context is complete at 4985 tokens; Doctor reports only the intentionally active session.

checks.name: reviewed_failure_boundaries
checks.result: Reviewed both behavior fixes and every observation boundary. Production supplies a private no-op observer and consumes no test fault environment variables. SQL projection/receipt failure tests preserve old stale or new fresh projection as appropriate and never report completion before its event commits.

acceptance.criterion: 并发 expected_revision/fingerprint 冲突可重现，不能发生静默丢更新。
覆盖文件写前、写后、重索引前后的中断，pending proposal 可恢复且不能假报完成。

limitations: Local macOS component, process, CLI/MCP stdio and current-project developer use. M9 cross-platform, E4, metric and release gates remain pending.
Per-source locks coordinate participating AWR writers. Fingerprint checks do not make arbitrary external editors or SQLite plus the filesystem one atomic transaction.
Process-kill evidence does not simulate machine power loss. Unreferenced staging files after interruption are retained; no automatic garbage collection was added.
Fixture helper and built-CLI tests are intentionally ignored in default Cargo runs and explicitly executed by the current contract runner.
